request.spec:
Show the activity of the sheet: for every user and every event in the sheet's audit file, one
line <user> <EVENT> <count>, sorted by user then event.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Show the activity of the sheet: for every user and every event in the sheet's audit file, one
line <user> <EVENT> <count>, sorted by user then event.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

agent.result_text:
The sheet's activity is now shown on the main screen: for each user and each event in the sheet's audit file, one line `<user> <EVENT> <count>`, sorted by user then event. All 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

- **Server:** a new `POST /api/audit/activity` endpoint in `AuditViewController.java`, backed by `activity(sheet)` in `AuditViewService.java`. It reads only the audit lines for that sheet and counts them by the `by=` user and the event name. Nothing is stored and nothing new is written to the audit file.
- **Front end:** a new component, `features/audit/activity.ts`, placed on the screen just below the audit viewer. Pressing the `activity-show` button lists each count as an `activity-line`, and the old list is cleared on each press. If the request fails, an `activity-error` message appears instead.

Two behaviours to know about:
- An audit line with no `by=` user isn't counted, since it has no user to put on a line.
- Sorting is plain text order, so capitalised user names would come before lower-case ones.
